registered_addition_groups.rationale: The sole occurrence is UTF-8 encoding of an already-canonical bounded comparison mapping immediately before SHA-256 computation for immutable observation, rule, and receipt identity. It performs no adaptive learning, legacy mutation, event append, persistence write, production integration, action, scheduling, speech, goal-authority transfer, migration authorization, or M3-E activation.

All nine occurrences are test-local deterministic label hashing, temporary AST import/call collection sets, and one deliberate frozen-dataclass assignment used only to prove immutability. They add no production mutation or adaptive capability and cannot access runtime or private persistence, append events, mutate legacy goal state, execute actions, schedule, speak, transfer legacy authority, authorize migration, or open M3-E.
